East German-style pedestrian signal figure (Ampelmannchen), designed 1961 by Karl Peglau: a stocky figure wearing a broad hat. Red phase ('Steher') shows the figure standing with arms stretched wide; green phase ('Geher') shows the figure striding forward. Found mainly on secondary/municipal streets in the former East Germany (Berlin and other eastern cities), not standardized nationwide.
